decode_gemv: 1-4 rows per warp, loads of the next row ahead, activations staged with a swizzle (wide rows with more than 2 tokens read through L1); same per-lane order for 1 and 4 tokens
decode_graphs: per index-score bucket: head with layer 0, the rest, and the drafter steps of a speculative round
expert_cache: device CLOCK directory over spare device memory plus KV positions beyond the request and the prompt workspace; union plan per pass built by all threads; misses read from mapped host memory with write-through; slots touched in a pass protected
expert_down: per (entry, 64 rows) blocks with staged activations, plan-order sum
index_keys: fp32 pooled, split-fp16 prompt-path index GEMM
kv_cache: fp8 e4m3 with an fp32 scale per 256-dim key or value vector (target and MTP layers)
ple_gather: 16-thread pool for decode passes, next round's rows gathered during the drafter stage; up to 48 threads for prompt chunks
prompt_experts: one batched copy per layer; chunks under 512 tokens copy experts routed by at most 4 tokens into a transient pool (prompt workspace tail) instead of the cache
sampling: greedy on device; temperature/top-p/top-k with crit Core's Sampler on host logits, one token per pass
speculation: greedy requests: MTP block as released, 3 drafts per round verified in one 4-token pass; drafting head re-encoded as MXFP8 (drafter only); MTP experts resident on the device; one-token passes for the last positions of the context
